name: DealMachine
shortDescription: Owner data and a driving app for property outreach. Basic is $99 per seat per month.
longDescription: DealMachine lists nationwide property and owner data, saved searches, and a Driving for Dollars app. Basic is $99 per seat per month with 10,000 data credits, and Pro is $149 per seat per month. Postcards are priced per piece.
pricingNotes: Basic is $99 per seat per month. Pro is $149 per seat per month. Mail is priced per postcard.
bestFor: Pulling owner records and tagging properties while driving
notIdealFor: Someone who wants postcards included in the seat price
strength: Basic is $99 per seat per month and includes nationwide owner data plus the Driving for Dollars app.
weakness: Postcards are pay as you go, and the listed price is per seat rather than one flat workspace fee.

useCaseFit.find-off-market: Lists owner data and a driving app, and Basic is $99 per seat per month.
useCaseFit.real-estate: Pulls owner records and tags a property during a drive.
